title: From coffee cherry to package
promptText: The diagram illustrates how harvested coffee cherries are processed into packaged roasted coffee. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features.
assetAltText: Seven-stage linear process from sorting coffee cherries through washing, drying, roasting, cooling, grinding, and packaging.

material.title: Producing packaged roasted coffee

stages.label: Sort
stages.description: Harvested cherries are inspected and damaged fruit is removed.

stages.label: Wash
stages.description: The selected cherries are washed and the beans are separated from the pulp.

stages.label: Dry
stages.description: The beans are spread on raised beds and dried in the sun.

stages.label: Roast
stages.description: Dry beans are roasted at high temperature until they reach the required colour.

stages.label: Cool
stages.description: The roasted beans are cooled rapidly with moving air.

stages.label: Grind
stages.description: Some beans are ground while the rest remain whole.

stages.label: Package
stages.description: Whole and ground coffee are sealed in labelled bags for distribution.

keyFeatures: The process is linear and has seven stages.
Physical preparation comes before heat treatment, followed by two alternative final products.

title: Treating water for reuse
promptText: The diagram shows how household wastewater is treated and returned for non-drinking uses in a residential district. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features.
assetAltText: Six-stage water-reuse cycle collecting household wastewater, screening, biological treatment, filtering, disinfecting, and redistributing it for gardens and toilets.

material.title: Residential wastewater reuse

stages.label: Collect
stages.description: Wastewater from sinks, showers, and washing machines enters a separate pipe network.

stages.label: Screen
stages.description: A screen removes large solid material from the collected water.

stages.label: Biological treatment
stages.description: Microorganisms break down dissolved organic matter in an aerated tank.

stages.label: Filter
stages.description: The treated water passes through sand and carbon filters.

stages.label: Disinfect
stages.description: Ultraviolet light destroys remaining harmful microorganisms.

stages.label: Redistribute
stages.description: A second pipe network supplies the water to gardens and toilet tanks, after which it can re-enter the system.

keyFeatures: The system forms a cycle rather than a single-use linear process.
Mechanical, biological, and disinfection stages occur before redistribution.

title: From wool to fabric
promptText: The diagram shows the stages in producing woollen fabric from raw fleece. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
assetAltText: Process diagram showing seven linear stages from shearing raw fleece to finishing woven woollen fabric.

material.title: Producing woollen fabric

stages.label: Shear
stages.description: Fleece is cut from the sheep in a single piece.

stages.label: Sort
stages.description: The fleece is graded by fibre length and any coarse wool is set aside.

stages.label: Scour
stages.description: Sorted wool is washed in warm water to remove grease and dirt.

stages.label: Card
stages.description: Clean fibres are combed until they lie in the same direction.

stages.label: Spin
stages.description: The combed fibres are drawn out and twisted into yarn.

stages.label: Weave
stages.description: Yarn is woven on a loom to form lengths of cloth.

stages.label: Finish
stages.description: The cloth is washed, dyed and pressed before dispatch.

keyFeatures: The process is linear and has seven stages.
Cleaning and alignment both precede any twisting or weaving.

title: How a medicine is approved
promptText: The diagram shows the stages a new medicine passes through before it can be sold. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
assetAltText: Process diagram showing six stages from laboratory testing to monitoring an approved medicine in use.

material.title: Approving a new medicine

stages.label: Laboratory
stages.description: A candidate compound is tested on cells and tissue outside the body.

stages.label: Animal study
stages.description: The compound is tested on animals to check safety and dose.

stages.label: Small trial
stages.description: A small group of healthy volunteers receives the compound under supervision.

stages.label: Large trial
stages.description: Hundreds of patients receive either the compound or an existing treatment.

stages.label: Review
stages.description: A regulator examines the trial evidence and decides whether to approve.

stages.label: Monitor
stages.description: Effects are recorded after approval and the licence can be withdrawn.

keyFeatures: The process is linear and has six stages, with testing groups widening at each step.
Assessment continues after approval rather than ending at it.
